agent_messages: The conjunction uses two minimal-element facts: `Nat.find` is the least witness, so \(n\) lies below it exactly when no smaller \(m<n\) satisfies \(p\). Likewise, Chebyshev’s \(\theta(x)\) sums \(\log p\) over primes \(p\le x\); since the smallest prime is \(2\), its support is empty when \(x<2\).
